cases.title: Verify published stage columns and value formatting
steps: Inspect the project with a stage ref_id.
Inspect the project with no stage ref_id.
Check the participant and date values.
cases.expected: The table shows Stage Code when at least one row has ref_id and omits it when no row has ref_id. Participants shows active/total, using 0 for a missing value. Missing dates show '-'. Other listed columns are present.
cases.setup: Prepare one project with a published stage row containing ref_id and one project where no stage row contains ref_id. Include a missing participant count and a missing bidding date.
gaps: Cannot prepare or select two projects with controlled ref_id presence and absence; the fixed prepared project's ref_id values are unspecified, so Stage Code visibility cannot be asserted for either condition.
Cannot introduce a missing participant count or compare active/total formatting against stage counts using the catalog's supported API-value keys.
Cannot introduce a missing bidding date to verify that its cell displays '-'.

steps.note: Open the fixed prepared project's summary.
Verify the stage title column is present.
Verify the pending actions column is present.
Verify the participants column label is present; this does not check count formatting.
Verify the bidding start column is present.
Verify the bidding end column is present.
Record the available rows for manual inspection without claiming conditional columns or value formatting have been verified.

cases.title: Open a draft RFQ-to-auction stage
steps: Inspect the destination screen and URL.
cases.expected: The create screen opens for the draft stage and carries the draftEventId for that stage. No auction-team check prevents the navigation.
cases.setup: Prepare a non-draft project containing a draft RFQ-to-auction stage.
gaps: Establish the required non-draft project containing a draft RFQ-to-auction stage within the fixed prepared state.
Click the required draft Auction entry and verify its create-screen destination and stage-specific draftEventId; that entry is unavailable in this prepared event.
Verify that no auction-team check blocks the draft auction navigation, since the required navigation cannot be exercised.

cases.title: Verify overview project identity and open tender visibility
steps: Inspect the Project ID and Created at values.
Check the Open Tender Event value.
cases.expected: Project ID is shown as '#<refId>' and Created at uses DATE_TIME formatting. Open Tender Event shows 'Yes' only when is_show_under_open_events is enabled; it is not shown as Yes when disabled.
cases.setup: Prepare one project with refId and created-at data, with is_show_under_open_events enabled. Repeat with the configuration disabled.
gaps: Prepare or verify projects with is_show_under_open_events explicitly enabled and disabled; the prepared event has fixed default settings and no step changes this configuration.
Compare Project ID with '#<refId>': expect_api_value does not support refId, and no expected reference ID is supplied.
Compare Created at with the creation timestamp rendered using DATE_TIME formatting: neither the timestamp nor an assertion for this formatting is available.
Assert Open Tender Event is Yes when enabled and is not Yes when disabled: neither configuration state is established, and the field's exact label and locator are unconfirmed.
